knownTotals.note: 12 per set; 100% only needs ONE complete set; Collector's Item via cards needs all 144 mailed
8 in New Austin (Epilogue only); 5 Ambarino, 2 Lemoyne, 12 New Hanover, 3 West Elizabeth

trophies.name: Collector's Item
trophies.officialDescription: Complete one of the Collectable strands.
trophies.earnedWhen: When the Stranger quest behind any ONE collectible strand is fully completed (items mailed and final visit done).
howTo: Pick one strand: Rock Carvings (Geology for Beginners - fastest), Dinosaur Bones (A Test of Faith), Cigarette Cards (Smoking and other Hobbies - all 12 sets mailed), or Exotics (Duchesses and other Animals).
Collect every item of that strand.
Mail the locations/sets from any post office, wait the required days, then finish the final meeting with the quest giver.
tips: Only strands tied to a Stranger count; dreamcatchers are not a strand for this trophy (PowerPyx).
You will need rock carvings, bones and exotics anyway for Best in the West.

trophies.name: Western Stranger
trophies.earnedWhen: After completing full multi-part stranger strands; can be finished after the story.
howTo: Complete 10 of the 22 eligible strands from first to last part (see notes list).
Keep going past 10 if it does not pop - PowerPyx reports it can need 12+.
tips: Single-part/optional strands (All That Glitters, Fundraiser, Help a Brother Out, The Widow of Willard's Rest) do not count per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Best in the West
trophies.earnedWhen: Post-game clean-up; graves and New Austin items need the Epilogue.
howTo: Collectibles category: 1 point of interest, 9 graves (post-story), 1 full cigarette card set, complete A Test of Faith (30 bones), A Fisher of Fish (13 legendary fish), Duchesses and other Animals (exotics), Geology for Beginners (10 carvings), A Better World, A New Friend (5 hunting requests), 1 treasure hunt chain, all 20 dreamcatchers.
Missions & events: story, 10 stranger strands, 5 bounties, 25 chance encounters, 1 gang ambush, 6 gang hideouts.
Compendium, player (all 90 challenges, max cores, bonding 4) and miscellaneous tasks - see other research areas.

notes: Trophies that depend on this area: Collector's Item (silver, any 1 of 4 strands), Western Stranger (bronze, 10 strands), Best in the West (gold, 100%), plus It's Art (squirrel statue, from A Better World A New Friend) and Paying Respects (9 graves). No trophy needs all cigarette cards specifically. (sources: ppx-trophy, wiki-trophies)

100% (Best in the West) needs: 1 cigarette card set, all 30 bones (A Test of Faith), all 20 dreamcatchers, all 10 rock carvings (Geology for Beginners), all exotics (Duchesses), all 13 legendary fish (A Fisher of Fish), all 5 hunting requests (A Better World, A New Friend), 1 treasure hunt chain, 1 point of interest, 9 graves, 6 gang hideouts. (sources: wiki-100, ppx-100, r2o-100)

Collecting items alone does nothing for 100%/Collector's Item: bones, carvings and card sets must be mailed at a post office, time must pass (about 1 day bones, 2 days carvings), then the final visit to the quest giver completes the strand. (sources: ppx-bones, ppx-rc, wiki-rc)

Cigarette card shortcut: buy Premium Cigarettes at a general store, drop the packs from the satchel and rebuy; each pack gives a random card. Roughly $700-$2000 depending on satchel/honor; rewards and fencing duplicates recoup it. Do NOT sell a card you still need - mailing needs the physical card even if the compendium shows it. (sources: ppx-cards, wiki-cards)
Premium Cigarettes are sold at Armadillo, Rhodes, Saint Denis, Strawberry, Tumbleweed, Valentine, Van Horn Trading Post and Wallace Station general stores. (sources: wiki-cards)

Phineas T. Ramsbottom (Smoking and other Hobbies) appears at Flatneck Station from Chapter 2 after 'Who is Not Without Sin'. About one card per set only spawns in the world after accepting his quest. (sources: ppx-cards, wiki-cards)
Set-completion rewards: first set mailed = Vintage Civil War Handcuffs; all 12 = extra $200. (sources: wiki-cards, r2o-cards)
Picking up another card after completing Smoking and other Hobbies can re-open it in the log (wiki oversight). (sources: wiki-cards)
Dinosaur bones: 8 of 30 are in New Austin, so A Test of Faith can only be finished as John in the Epilogue. (sources: ppx-bones, wiki-bones, gr-bones)

Explorer challenges (part of all 90 challenges for 100%): rank 1 = find any treasure map; ranks 2-10 = find a treasure, where intermediate maps count. Jack Hall + Poisonous Trail + High Stakes are enough; Landmarks of Riches (starts at the obelisk NW of Owanjila) and Elemental Trail (Epilogue, starts SW of Tumbleweed) are optional. Torn/Sketched maps do not count. (sources: wiki-explorer, ppx-treasure, wiki-treasure)

Gang hideouts for 100%: Six Point Cabin (Ch2), Shady Belle (Ch3), Beaver Hollow (Ch5), Hanging Dog Ranch (Ch6) are automatic from story; Thieves Landing and Fort Mercer must be cleared in the Epilogue. (sources: ppx-gang, ppx-100)

Eligible Western Stranger strands (22, PowerPyx): Noblest of Men and a Woman, Smell of the Grease Paint, Arcadia for Amateurs, American Dreams, A Fine Night For It, Geology for Beginners, A Test of Faith, Smoking and other Hobbies, He's British of Course, A Fisher of Fish, Iniquities of History, No Good Deed, Oh Brother, A Bright Bouncing Boy, Mercies of Knowledge, The Artist's Way, Ties That Bind Us, Duchesses and other Animals, Idealism and Pragmatism for Beginners, Wisdom of the Elders, The Veteran, American Inferno Burnt Out. (sources: ppx-strangers, tt-ws)

Duchesses and other Animals opens in Chapter 4 after 'The Gilded Cage'; saving Algernon from choking is NOT required (another guest saves him). Cash total $750 (wiki) / $760 (PowerPyx) plus Exotic Hat and Algernon's Revolver. (sources: wiki-duchesses, ppx-duchesses)

Egret/heron/spoonbill farming tip: noon in the western Bayou Nwa; to respawn, ride away (e.g. to Rhodes), fast travel, sleep, return. Plants glow blue in Eagle Eye and never despawn. (sources: ppx-exotics)
